summary.name: PagerDuty Incident Response Documentation
summary.one_liner: A free, cut-down public version of PagerDuty's internal incident response handbook covering on-call preparation, major incident handling, and postmortems.
use_cases: Preparing new employees for on-call duty
Setting up a formal major incident response process
Training incident commanders, scribes and deputies
Writing and running postmortems after incidents
Planning crisis communications and customer liaison
summary.what_it_does: The site is a documentation collection describing PagerDuty's incident response process, adapted from its internal handbook. It covers what on-call involves, how alerting principles decide what pages an engineer, and how incidents and severity levels are defined before they happen. It describes incident roles such as Incident Commander, Scribe and Deputy, along with training guides for each role. It also includes guidance for during and after incidents, including a postmortem process, a postmortem template and a guide to effective postmortems, plus separate sections on security incidents and crisis response.
notable: Cut-down version of PagerDuty's internal major incident documentation
Includes a postmortem template and guide to writing effective postmortems
Covers role-specific training for Incident Commander, Scribe, Deputy and liaisons
Includes a crisis response section beyond technical incidents
caveats: Described as a cut-down version of internal documentation, so not every internal detail is included
Intended mainly for on-call practitioners and those setting up an incident process
